paragraphs: R' Chana bar Sha’ina, Avodah Zarah 75a; Vayikra Rabbah 5:2 has R' Yochanan bar Sha’ona.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ע״ז עה. is read as Avodah Zarah 75a under the period convention; ויק״ר פ״ה-ב as Vayikra Rabbah chapter 5 section 2, not an unexplained 5-b. Older machine פ״ה״ב differs in punctuation. Neither locator is independently checked against a named edition.

Both the given-name difference Chana/Yochanan and patronymic difference Sha’ina/Sha’ona remain. The source’s juxtaposition does not independently bind identities. Both personal title abbreviations remain R'.
